name: SBI Junior Associates (Customer Support and Sales)

organization.name: State Bank of India (Central Recruitment and Promotion Department)

summary: Clerical-cadre recruitment in SBI, state by state: you apply for one state and must know its local language. Online Prelims and Mains, then a local language test. Starting basic Rs 26,730; SBI states total starting pay of about Rs 46,000 a month at a metro.

status.note: Held every year. 2026 cycle: Prelims tentatively September 2026 and Mains November 2026.

posts.name: Junior Associate (Customer Support and Sales)
posts.responsibilities: Counter services, cash, accounts, customer support and product sales.

relaxations.category: Trained SBI apprentices (engaged on or after 1 Jan 2022)

eligibility.domicile: You apply for one state or UT only and must be proficient in its local language (Telugu or Urdu for Telangana, Telugu for Andhra Pradesh, Kannada for Karnataka). A language test is held after Mains unless your Class 10 or 12 marksheet shows the language.

education.summary: Graduation in any discipline. Final-year students may apply with proof of passing by the date in the advertisement.

eligibility.examVsPost: Vacancies are state-wise; you compete only within the state you choose.
disqualifications: Failing the local language test means no appointment.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: Local language proficiency of the chosen state is required.

stages.name: Preliminary (online)
stages.notes: 100 marks, 1 hour. No sectional minimum; about 10 times the vacancies go to Mains by aggregate.

stages.name: Main (online)
stages.notes: 190 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours 40 minutes. Minimum aggregate and sectional marks set by the bank (5% relaxation for reserved categories). SBI apprentices get 5 bonus marks.

stages.name: Local language test
stages.notes: Qualifying; waived if Class 10 or 12 records show the language.

selection.meritCalculation: Final selection on Mains marks, state-wise and category-wise.
selection.languages: English, Hindi and the regional language as per the advertisement.

statistics.note: Regular vacancies across all states (backlog listed separately).

salary.officialGrossNote: SBI states total starting emoluments of about Rs 46,000 a month at a metro such as Mumbai, including DA and allowances (rate at the time of the advertisement).
salary.increments: As per the scale; graduates get two advance increments (24,050 + 2 = 26,730).

progression.timeline: After eligible service and promotion test

career.promotionNotes: Internal promotion to officer is a common path in SBI.

benefits.detail: Medical, leave fare concession, staff loans as per SBI rules.

workLife.transfers: Within the state; no inter-state transfer for 5 years.

difficulty.rationale: Simple syllabus, tight timers, very large applicant pool, state-wise merit.

ratings.rationale: You stay in your chosen state; internal promotion to officer is possible.

factors.note: Required unless school records show the language.

gaps: State-wise vacancy figures for AP, Telangana and Karnataka not reproduced.
